title: Ukrainian Pilaf Pasta Bake
description: A hearty, comforting dish that combines the flavors of pilaf and pasta. Perfect for a cozy evening meal.

ingredients.name: yellowed
ingredients.notes: such as yellow bell pepper or onion

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, sauté yellowed and garlic in a little oil until softened.
Add cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine.
If using chicken broth, stir it in to create a creamy sauce.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, pilaf mixture, and chicken broth (if using).
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional yellowed and garlic if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
